symptom: `describe page` of a Studio Pro page whose button, outside every data container, opens another page with the enclosing page's own parameter (GenAI Showcase wizard buttons; minimal blank-app case) printed `show page M.Next(Task = $Task)`, and `check` refused it: MDL-PAGEARG01 "there is no context object at all" (12 occurrences in the 2026-10-12 round-trip runs).
cause: mxcli only ever wrote a show page action with an EMPTY ParameterMappings array (#296: the inferred context object; an explicit $currentObject is CE0115), so it concluded that outside a data widget no argument can be stored (#1029) and refused it. Studio Pro has a second form: an explicit Forms$PageParameterMapping {Argument "", Variable: Forms$PageVariable{PageParameter|SnippetParameter}} — the parameter bound by name, which needs no context object. The writer could not produce it, and gen's PageParameterMapping constructor stamps the wrong $Type (Forms$FormCallArgument, i.e. LayoutCallArgument).
file: mdl/executor/cmd_pages_builder_v3.go (showPage: namedParameterArgument before the refusal); mdl/executor/cmd_pages_showpage_args.go (namedParameterArgument, docParams for the check-time walk); mdl/executor/validate_widgets.go (validateDocumentWidgetTree with documentEntityParameters); mdl/backend/modelsdk/widget_write.go (pageSettingsWithMappings, SetTypeName); sdk/pages PageClientParameterMapping.VariableKind
insight: The refusal was right about the form mxcli wrote and wrong about Mendix: the reference was in ako/TestApp all along (WorkflowCommons TaskAssignmentHelper_UserTask_Reassign PageParameter, Snip_UserTask_Detail SnippetParameter) — scan Studio Pro content for the mapping shape before concluding a binding cannot be stored. Two mxbuild 11.6.6 runs settled it: explicit mapping 0 errors, the same script with the mapping forced empty 2x CE1571. Do not trust gen's storage name for Forms$PageParameterMapping: NewPageParameterMapping writes Forms$FormCallArgument and mxbuild cannot even load the page ("LayoutCallArgument does not contain a constructor with a parameter of type PageSettings") — only a real mx run shows it, the unit tests were green. PageSettings.parameterMappings is 9.7+, so below that the argument is still refused. The context object stays inferred (no churn on existing pages). Two TestApp allowlist entries struck; Snip_UserTask_Detail now passes exec and exposes unrelated getput drift.
